name: Zainco Technology for Internet Services and Information Technology
name_long: Zainco Technology for Internet Services and Information Technology
notes:
Zainco Technology (legally: Zainco Company for Internet Services and Information Technology JSC) is an internet service provider based in Jenin, Palestine, founded in 2011.

We provide WiFiber high-speed broadband, business connectivity, IPTV and IT services to residential and business customers in Jenin city and the surrounding areas of Jenin Governorate.

Zainco operates AS215886 with independent address space allocated by the RIPE NCC, and participates in MANRS (Mutually Agreed Norms for Routing Security). Open peering policy - no contract or ratio required. Peering and NOC requests: noc@zainco.ps

Zainco Technology is an independent Palestinian company and is not affiliated with Zain Group, Zain Jordan, or any other company operating under the "Zain" brand.

Website: https://zainco.ps
